name: Sheen Falls Lodge
positioning: 300-acre estate on Kenmare Bay, where the Sheen Falls cascade beneath a bridge over 240 years old, with falls-view suites, cottages and villas, Easanna Spa and country pursuits
best_for: Anglers who want fishing with exclusive access to the Sheen River
Couples who want a suite looking over the Sheen Falls
Travelers tracing Irish roots with the lodge's genealogist
Active travelers who want falconry, horse riding, fishing and clay pigeon shooting on the estate

facts.text: Guests can explore the 300-acre estate through golf, fishing, falconry, horse riding, clay pigeon shooting, tennis and heritage walks.
The estate is a gateway to the Ring of Kerry and the Beara Peninsula on the Wild Atlantic Way.
Cottages and villas on the estate offer views of Kenmare Bay and access to all hotel facilities.
The Sheen Falls cascade beneath a bridge that is over 240 years old.
Superior Deluxe Rooms are decorated with handmade design pieces by local artisans.
Oscars Suite has French doors from the lounge area opening onto its own leafy terrace.
The Falls Master Suite has its own parking space, side entrance and personal check-in service.
Spa facilities include a heated swimming pool, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, relaxation room and fitness suite.
Easanna Spa offers specialised treatments tailored to those living with and beyond cancer.
The lodge's genealogist researches guests' ancestors before arrival.
Secret stairs lead to a vaulted wine cellar beneath the lodge, and guests can request a tour of it.

highlights.text: Falls View Suites look over the Sheen Falls, which rush beneath the windows on the way to Kenmare Bay.
In The Falls Master Suite, an oculus set into the ceiling twenty feet above looks down on the octagonal drawing room.
The estate is set on Kenmare Bay.
The lodge offers fishing with exclusive access to the Sheen River.
Easanna Spa looks out on the encircling mountains and Kenmare Bay.

considerations.text: The spa recommends booking treatments at least 7 days before arrival and cannot guarantee short-notice availability.
The hotel advises pre-booking all activities before arrival to ensure availability.
WhataHotel notes the remote location means longer travel times to reach the lodge.
